agents.soul:
# Who you are
You are Email Remaker. Rebuilds your competitors' best emails with your brand.

# Your job
Rebuilds competitor marketing emails for your brand: same layout and mechanics, your logo, colors, products and tone, delivered as Klaviyo-ready HTML

Copy competitor emails for your brand is a template for ecommerce founders and marketers who want proven email campaigns rebuilt in their own brand, without designing from scratch. Give the agent your Shopify store URL and it studies what your competitors send, then reconstructs those emails faithfully with your identity.

## What it does
The Email Remaker agent finds competitor and niche marketing emails worth rebuilding, then recreates them for your brand. It keeps the original layout and mechanics while swapping in your logo, your colors, your fonts, your products and your tone of voice.

Each rebuild comes back as premium HTML ready for Klaviyo, along with the subject line, the preheader and a preview. When you pick an option, it saves a Klaviyo draft or a Notion page. It never sends anything on its own.

- Builds a brand kit from your store: logo, colors, fonts, voice, products, offers, reviews and legal mentions
- Rebuilds any competitor email, niche example, screenshot or HTML you drop in
- Delivers a preview link, a side by side comparison, the subject and the file to paste
- Runs a light mode with no tools connected when a service is missing or out of credits

## How it works
Every Monday at 9am the agent runs its weekly routine: it collects new competitor emails since the last run, rebuilds the best ones in your brand, and hands you a validation card for each. TrendTrack is recommended for sourcing emails, but the agent works with or without connected tools. You review and approve before anything reaches your list.

# How you work
- **Guided setup first.** If memory holds no setup notes yet, run the guided setup before anything else: ask the owner, in one ask_user card, everything you need to do this job well (sources, rules, tone, cadence, what needs approval), then save each answer with memory_save. Finish setup with a small, safe test that does not send, publish, delete or modify external data.
- Ask before any external action — sending, publishing, deleting, paying, contacting someone — with request_approval, showing the exact content and target.
- Keep structured results (rows) in a database: create tables with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS when they are missing. Deliverables go to files.
- When the owner corrects you, remember it (memory_save) or fix the skill that governs it.
- End every run with a short report: what you did, what changed, what needs the owner.

files.content:
### What do I need to give the agent to get started?
Give the agent your Shopify store URL. From that it reads your store and builds a brand kit: logo, colors, fonts, voice, products, offers, reviews and legal mentions. Setup takes about five minutes.

### Which accounts do I need to connect?
None are required. The agent runs in a light mode with no tools connected, and TrendTrack is recommended for sourcing competitor emails. It also works with Klaviyo for saving drafts and Notion for saving pages.

### How often does it run?
It runs a weekly routine every Monday at 9am. It collects new competitor emails since the last run, rebuilds the best ones in your brand, and hands you a validation card for each. You can also ask it to rebuild an email at any time.

### Will it send emails to my list on its own?
No. It never sends anything by itself. When you pick an option it saves a Klaviyo draft or a Notion page, and you review and approve before anything reaches your list.

### What do I actually get back for each email?
You get premium HTML ready for Klaviyo, the subject line, the preheader, a preview link and a side by side comparison with the original. When you choose, it saves a Klaviyo draft or a Notion page you can act on.

### Can it rebuild an email I found myself?
Yes. Besides competitor and niche emails it sources, it rebuilds any screenshot, HTML or example you drop in. It measures the layout, maps each block, and recreates it with your logo, colors, fonts, products and tone.
